title: The Exam That Stops All of China #shorts
description:
The gaokao, China's college entrance exam: 13.4 million students in 2025, police-guarded papers, quiet streets, and AI chatbots that switch off.

New China Short every day; full reality-show recap every Saturday. Subscribe to @mainlandunpacked.

Sources: Bloomberg, Fortune (June 2025). Footage: China News Service (CC BY).

scenes.text: Once a year, all of China slows down for one exam.
headline: ONE EXAM.
ONE SHOT.
scenes.image: File:Gate of Beijing 101 Middle School during NCEE2026 (20260607172055).jpg

scenes.text: It's called the gaokao. In 2025, about 13.4 million students took it.
scenes.say: It's called the gow-kow. In 2025, about thirteen point four million students took it.
scenes.label: students sat the 2025 gaokao
scenes.image: File:Examinees leaving 101 Middle School after first exam (20210607114526).jpg

scenes.text: For most of them, this one score decides which university they can get into.
Police guard the exam papers, traffic gets rerouted, and construction near test sites stops.
scenes.image: File:Gate of Beijing Bayi School during NCEE2025 (20250607154558).jpg

scenes.text: In 2025, several Chinese AI chatbots even switched off photo recognition during exam hours.
scenes.label: No photo answers during the exam
scenes.source: Reported for Tencent Yuanbao, Moonshot Kimi & others
scenes.image: File:Liangxiang High School Affiliated to BNU during NCEE2026 (20260607132401).jpg

scenes.text: Could you handle your whole future riding on one exam?
scenes.question: COULD YOU HANDLE IT?
